# Read Primitives — GROUP BY ALL Complex

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

GROUP BY ALL with multiple non-aggregate expressions

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o_orderdate) as order_month,
    o_orderpriority,
    COUNT(o_orderkey) as order_count,
    SUM(o_totalprice) as monthly_revenue
FROM orders
WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o_orderdate), o_orderpriority
ORDER BY order_month, o_orderpriority;
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def groupby_all_complex_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """GROUP BY ALL with multiple non-aggregate expressions."""
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    filtered = orders.filter(col("o_orderdate") >= lit(date(1995, 1, 1)))
    return (
        filtered.with_columns(col("o_orderdate").dt.truncate("1mo").alias("order_month"))
        .group_by("order_month", "o_orderpriority")
        .agg(
            col("o_orderkey").count().alias("order_count"),
            col("o_totalprice").sum().alias("monthly_revenue"),
        )
        .sort(["order_month", "o_orderpriority"])
    )
```
